description: This source file defines the ManagedBlockchainClient class used to interact with the Amazon Managed Blockchain service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations (both sync and async) related to blockchain networks, members, nodes, proposals, and resource tagging.

classes.name: ManagedBlockchainClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Managed Blockchain service, extending the base AwsClient class.
